title: curl: add --help subject common
body:
## Summary

This pull request (PR) adds a subject to the `-h, --help` option; using the options from [curl-cheat-sheet](https://github.com/curl/curl-cheat-sheet/tree/master), and several more from the [`curl` tutorial](https://curl.se/docs/tutorial.html) that are also typically found in some page from a Google search of "curl tutorial" (*or similar*). This is to address user feedback from the 2025 survey, adding a `--help` subject for what seems to be the most commonly used options.

### 1. `curl` 2025 Survey

In the section "Worst areas" only 159 responded to the question, but the top pick was documentation at 28.3%.

See [curl 2025 survey \[1\]](https://curl.se/docs/survey/2025-1.1/#:~:text=Worst%20areas)

`curl` is a large project with a lot to document, and no matter what; not everyone will find the docs convenient. I'm guessing this is true for all projects with massive amounts of documentation.

This PR will hopefully bring the documentation down a few points next year in this part of the survey.


### 2. `curl` 2025 Survey 

In the section "Which curl command line option do you think needs improvement and how?" one user wrote:

> --help: it’d be a bit more convenient if it had a few more of the most frequently used flags rather than needing to remember to do --help all or man curl.

See [curl 2025 survey \[2\]](https://curl.se/docs/survey/2025-1.1/#:~:text=help%20all)

This PR addresses that suggestion directly.

### Documented External Common Usage

If "curl tutorial", or anything similar is searched on Google, you'll find articles like the ones below. The options added to the `common` category that are not from the `curl-cheat-sheet` have been added if the option is in the `curl.se` tutorial, and one of the selected external tutorials below:

- [top 10 curl command](https://medium.com/@shekhawatmanvendrasingh78/top-10-curl-command-779a0b91d5c4)
- [Popular curl Examples](https://www.keycdn.com/support/popular-curl-examples)
- [Popular Curl -flags with short descriptions](https://reqbin.com/req/c-skhwmiil/curl-flags-example)

#### Options Included not in `curl-cheat-sheet`

- `-C, --continue-at`
- `-D, --dump-header`
- `--limit-rate`
- `-r, --range`
